periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented nearly vertically with a slight medial tilt of approximately 10-15 degrees toward the sagittal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches exhibit an elongated oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches show a distinct inferior tapering effect, with the geometric bulk situated in the upper two-thirds, ending in a narrowed point at the bottom.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is substantial, encompassing the entire shoulder girdle and extending vertically to cover approximately 35% of the visible upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned laterally with a wide inter-pinna distance, approximately equal to the width of the muzzle.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The apex of the pinnas is non-uniform, showing a tapered, sub-acute curvature rather than a smooth semicircular arc.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-tan pigmentation is present across the ventral and abdominal fur, as well as on the distal portions of the limbs, replacing the typical white pelage.
